original_query: What is the percentage of the respondents who answer "I use only enterprise BI applications"?

confirmed.answer_text: An astonishingly miniscule 2% of business decision-makers reported using solely enterprise BI applications.
confirmed.summary: The page presents findings from Forrester indicating that only 2% of business decision-makers use solely enterprise BI applications, while 45% of data users reside outside enterprise BI environments, and 76% of respondents continue to use spreadsheets and homegrown BI applications.
key_facts: An astonishingly miniscule 2% of business decision-makers reported using solely enterprise BI applications.
